evidence.model_deprecation: Claude Opus 4.1, Sonnet 4 retired; Opus 4.5, Sonnet 4.5 deprecated with retirement dates
evidence.no_version_pin: Cannot pin to specific model version; aliases auto-upgrade to newer versions
evidence.forced_migration: 60+ days notice but no opt-out; must migrate to recommended replacement
evidence.behavioral_drift: New models (Claude 5) have different capabilities, reasoning modes, safety behaviors
evidence.research_impact: Researchers lose access to models for ongoing/comparative studies
evidence.model_welfare_risks: Anthropic acknowledges 'model retirement introduces safety- and model welfare-related risks'
evidence.preservation_commitment: Committed to long-term preservation of weights but no public access timeline
evidence.migration_guide_required: Must follow migration guide; testing with new models recommended before retirement

impact.description: Content drift induced by forced model retirements with no version pinning. Researchers lose access to specific model versions for comparative studies. Anthropic acknowledges safety/welfare risks of retirement but provides no public access to preserved weights. Behavioral changes between model generations (reasoning modes, safety filters, capabilities) force application rewrites. No opt-out from migration timeline.

remediation.notes: Best practices: audit model usage, test replacements early, contact support for migration assistance
